text: Provides building blocks for semantic search and knowledge retrieval inside agents or apps
quote: Build semantic search and knowledge retrieval into your agent or app

text: Lets you build an AI assistant that compiles your data into context and returns grounded, cited answers
quote: Compile your data into a context and query it for grounded, cited answers

text: Supports publishing a no-code knowledge app from a template (public preview)
quote: Publish a no-code knowledge app from a template (public preview)

text: Works with Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor and other agentic coding tools as a backend
quote: Use Pinecone with Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and other agentic tools

text: Official MCP server lets agents search docs, manage indexes, upsert data, and query Pinecone
quote: Connect AI agents to Pinecone through the MCP server to search docs, manage indexes, and query data from Claude, Cursor, Antigravity, or Claude Code.

text: A single index can serve full-text (BM25), semantic, and sparse-vector search together
quote: A single index can serve full-text search (BM25 with Lucene queries), semantic search, and sparse-vector search together, often covering what previously required two indexes.

text: Built-in full-text/BM25 keyword search over text fields with no embedding model required
quote: Full-text search is BM25 token matching with Lucene query syntax over text fields in your schema... No model required

text: Queries can select ranking method via score_by: text (BM25), query_string (Lucene), dense or sparse vector
quote: When you search, you rank results via score_by: text (BM25), query_string (Lucene), dense_vector, or sparse_vector.

text: Hybrid search combines keyword and semantic retrieval, including reciprocal rank fusion of separate searches
quote: Combine keyword and semantic retrieval in Pinecone with a text-match filter on a dense search, or by fusing separate searches with reciprocal rank fusion.

text: Search queries can be narrowed with metadata filter expressions using operators like eq, in, gt
quote: Narrow Pinecone search results by adding metadata filter expressions to your query, using operators like eq,eq, eq,in, gt,andgt, and gt,andand for precise retrieval.

text: Multitenancy implemented via one namespace per tenant on a serverless index
quote: Implement multitenancy in Pinecone using a **serverless index with one namespace per tenant**.

text: Serverless indexes can be backed up and restored via SDK, API, or console
quote: Create backups of serverless indexes to protect data, copy indexes, or experiment with configurations using the Pinecone SDK, API, or console.

text: Role-based access controls (RBAC) manage API key permissions and resource access
quote: You can manage API key permissions in the Pinecone console... Pinecone uses role-based access controls (RBAC) to manage access to resources.

text: Inference API generates vector embeddings and reranks results using Pinecone-hosted models
quote: Use the Inference API to generate vector embeddings and rerank results using embedding models and reranking models hosted on Pinecone's infrastructure.

text: Console or CLI/terminal can be used to monitor performance and manage indexes
quote: Monitor performance, explore your data, and manage indexes from a clean, fast console — or stay in the terminal. Your call.

text: SSO lets organizations manage team access to Pinecone via their identity provider
quote: SSO allows organizations to manage their teams’ access to Pinecone through their identity management solution.

text: Audit logs record detailed user and API actions within Pinecone
quote: Audit logs provide a detailed record of user and API actions that occur within Pinecone.

text: Security features include CMEK encryption, service accounts, and Private Endpoints for network isolation
quote: Overview of Pinecone security features for production: API keys, SSO, service accounts, audit logs, CMEK encryption, backups, and Private Endpoints.
